- **trap** `e2e/count-requestanimationframe-page-before-reporting-picture`: Count requestAnimationFrame in the page before reporting a picture that will not leave. The desktop browser pane can render no frames at all while it reports visible, so every GSAP exit freezes where it stood until a screenshot or a click forces a frame; an ordinary visible browser and Playwright clear the same Out in about a second.
